svg.desc: MikroTik RIF Viewer DMG background master. Crop-proof by design: a full-bleed light vertical gradient with faint distributed arcs only. No positioned art (no drop-zone rings, no arrow, no label pills, no text, no baked-in icons) because Finder windows can be resized and icon slots move independently of the picture. Export at 1320x800 (@2x of the 660x400pt window).
